subject: mathematics
concept: Finding the volume of liquid in a partially filled rectangular tank
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student pours virtual liquid to a marked height in a tank and calculates the filled volume
exercise.pictorial: Student calculates filled volume from a pictured tank showing liquid height, length, and width
exercise.abstract: Student solves for the volume of liquid in a tank given its dimensions and fill height

misconception_flags: uses the tank's full height instead of the liquid's fill height

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
